title: Energy Department Announces $2.8 Billion Loan to Strengthen Grid Reliability and Help Lower Costs in Wyoming
summary_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Energy’s Office of Energy Dominance Financing today announced a conditional loan commitment of up to $2.8 billion for Grid United’s Wyoming Intertie project to lower electricity costs and strengthen grid reliability in Wyoming

title: Commission approves €9.5 billion Dutch State aid to support offshore wind energy
summary_excerpt: The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, a €9.5 billion Dutch scheme to support renewable electricity production from two offshore wind farms in the North Sea.
